verdict.rationale: Sentry's CLI docs describe release and source-map management tied to deploys, and 'Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments' shows the product surfaces which commits/changes likely caused an issue — both support correlating regressions with releases and code changes. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated release/deploy tracking dashboard, deploy health view, or configuration-change tracking beyond code commits. Missing for 10: explicit release/deploy health dashboard documentation, configuration-change (non-code) tracking evidence, and independent confirmation of suspect-commit accuracy.
